{{Quote|&hellip;the stormtroopers discovered to their considerable dismay that Republic marines, unlike many other enemies, didn't seem at all intimidated by the stormtroopers' vibroknucklers&hellip;|Stormtroopers facing New Republic Marines at the Battle of Mindor|<ref name="Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>}}
'''New Republic Marines''' were the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]-to-ship assault and defense infantry of the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]]. 18,000 members of this infantry fought at the [[Battle of Mindor]], which was a victory for them. [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] Marines were armed with [[DH-17 blaster rifle/Legends|DH-17 blaster rifle]]. Though for close combat, the Marines equipped themselves with [['aKraB clip-point vibrodagger/Legends|AKraB vibrodaggers]], which could easily cut through [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]].
